question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4 i.e. Mischievious**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Mischievious"** is incorrectly spelt. It is often a common mistake made by learners. (गलत वर्तनी)

 
 
• **Example:** ✗ The boy was very mischievious in class. (Incorrect)
 
 
 
• The correct spelling is **"Mischievous"**, which means causing or showing fondness for trouble in a playful way. (शरारती)
 
 
• **Example:** ✓ The mischievous child hid his brother’s shoes before school.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is: **Mischievous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Occurred** (गलत वर्तनी) — The correct spelling is **Occurred** (घटित होना).

 
 
• **Example:** The accident occurred late at night.
 
 
 
• **Questionnaire** (प्रश्नावली): A set of printed or written questions with a choice of answers.
 
 
• **Example:** Students were asked to fill in a questionnaire about their study habits.
 
 
 
• **Peculiar** (अजीब/विशेष): Something strange or unusual.
 
 
• **Example:** There was a peculiar smell in the room.
